description: Conservative allowlist for deriving organization associations from explicitly public professional email addresses.

rules.note: Huawei-owned professional email domain. Subdomains such as china.huawei.com inherit this mapping.
HiSilicon professional email is rolled up to the canonical parent-company node 华为 in this graph.

notes: Only public_email is eligible for automatic inference; arbitrary email-like strings in prose are not mined.
A mapped corporate domain proves an organization association at the time/source of the email, not necessarily current employment.
Personal email providers and GitHub noreply addresses never create company edges.
Partner/contractor domains are not mapped to a client or platform company without separate evidence.
Add a domain only when its ownership and canonical company target are verified.
